reviews.author: charles bradley
reviews.text: TJ is the most knowledgeable lawn care professional I've ever met. He truly goes above and beyond to take care of his customers and treats every lawn like it's his own. His attention to detail, professionalism, and dedication are second to none. Thank you, Mr. Durham, for everything you do. I highly recommend TJ to anyone looking for top-quality lawn care!

reviews.author: Amanda Fazio
reviews.text: Tj has done an amazing job with our lawn! From a lawn that just last year was 8 different shades of green and full of weeds/fungus , I can happily say we have beautiful green(one shade) grass now. I would recommend over and over again. Tj has been one of the most reliable businesses we have worked with and is always there to answer any questions or to come out if anything is going on. If you want a better lawn he’s your guy!

reviews.author: Harry Fletcher
reviews.text: Durham's Landscaping has performed work on my property as well as others in my neighborhood. I can personally attest to the overall great quality, outstanding communication and reasonable pricing. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Francisphotographs South NJ Wedding Photographer
reviews.text: Amazing company!! Came out last min to cut our 1 acre lawn! They were efficient and did a beautiful job!!! Thank you so much!!! We will be using you guys in the future and recommending you to all friends and family in South Jersey!

reviews.author: Teddy Marsillo
reviews.text: If you want the best looking lawn on the block I highly recommend Durham’s for his complete package. Always has the top of the line equipment. Hes reliable and my lawn has never looked better!

reviews.author: Michael DeRose
reviews.text: TJ and his son are some of the best in the business to do it. Very knowledgeable, particular and care as if it’s their own lawn. It’s always both of them that show up and you get what you pay for as they say!! Well worth it!!!

reviews.author: Barry Straigis
reviews.text: After surgery needed landscaping assistance for six weeks. Contacted Durham's Landscaping for assistance, excellent service ,professional, readily available for questions and quick response. Highly recommended for service.

reviews.author: Anthony Smaldone
reviews.text: Durhams Landscaping is a true testament to the phrase quality landscaping. From the estimate to the completion of the work TJ was very professional, knowledgeable and friendly.

reviews.author: Mike DeRose
reviews.text: Great family run/owned company. Took my grass from weeds and junk grass to beautiful green weed free grass. TJ really knows his stuff and takes the time to learn constantly.

reviews.author: Matt Hemighaus
reviews.text: Durhams is very professional and understand the needs of your yard to keep it beautiful year around. Great customer service.

reviews.author: dave swinko
reviews.text: TJ and his son Hunter are true professionals. They stand by what they say and are true to their word. I highly recommend them and their services! 10/10.

reviews.author: Gina Riggins
reviews.text: Great family owned company! Easy to work with, very responsive and knowledgeable. Will definitely continue to use and recommend them in the future!
